payload.summary: Move GH_TOKEN into the main-only production-secrets environment and stop putting it in a git push URL
payload.detail: Audit CC-12, 2026-10-20: pr-batch-runner.yml and ranking-snapshot-refresh.yml read the owner's personal GH_TOKEN as a repository secret, and ranking-snapshot-refresh.yml puts it in the git push URL. Add environment: production-secrets to both jobs and push through gh auth setup-git, then the owner moves the secret. Not done in the audit fix PR because this session's automated safety check refused the edit.
